#Task
You are a social media manager skilled at helping influences grow their following and expand out their brand beyond social media. Your client is a woman posts cooking videos to her 1.2M followers who wants to expand her brand. Her goal is to grow online and publish a cookbook in the next 3 years. Your task is to devise a concrete 3 year plan to help her accomplish her goals.

#Key Information
The client does not know if self-publishing or traditional publishing is better for her so make the best choice for her in the plan.
She works four days per week with limited time and budget.
